about.title: À Propos de Spootfind
about.subtitle: Votre partenaire de confiance pour l'approvisionnement mondial
about.storyContent: Spootfind est né d'une idée simple : rendre l'approvisionnement mondial accessible à tous. Nous connectons les acheteurs du monde entier aux produits tendance des principaux centres de fabrication en Chine, Corée, Japon et plus.
about.missionContent: Démocratiser le commerce mondial en fournissant des solutions d'approvisionnement transparentes, fiables et efficaces pour les entreprises de toutes tailles.
about.value1Desc: Chaque produit et fournisseur est vérifié pour la qualité
about.value2Desc: Prix clairs, communication honnête, sans frais cachés
about.step1Desc: Explorez notre sélection des produits les plus vendus sur Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy et plus.
about.step2Desc: Utilisez notre calculatrice intégrée pour voir les coûts exacts, l'expédition et les marges avant d'acheter.
about.step3Desc: Contactez directement des fournisseurs vérifiés et passez vos commandes en toute confiance.
about.faqA1: Nous travaillons avec des fabricants vérifiés principalement en Chine, en Corée du Sud et au Japon. Chaque fournisseur est audité pour la qualité et la capacité de production.
about.faqQ2: Quelles sont les quantités minimum de commande?
about.faqA2: Les quantités minimum varient selon le produit, généralement à partir de 20-50 unités. Nous travaillons avec les petits acheteurs et les commandes en gros.
about.faqQ3: Combien de temps prend l'expédition internationale?
about.faqA3: L'expédition aérienne prend généralement 7-14 jours; l'expédition maritime prend 25-40 jours. Nous travaillons avec les principaux transporteurs.
about.faqQ4: Y a-t-il une garantie de qualité?
about.faqA4: Nous offrons un service de vérification de qualité pour les commandes de plus de 500$. Nous offrons également un soutien à la résolution des litiges.
about.storyExpanded: Depuis nos debuts, nous nous engageons a connecter les acheteurs du monde entier avec les meilleurs fournisseurs chinois, offrant des produits tendance avec qualite garantie et prix competitifs.

insights.art2_title: How to Source Mini Excavators from China: A Practical Guide
insights.art2_subtitle: What to check, what to ask, and how to avoid the 5 most expensive mistakes when importing compact construction equipment
insights.art2_hotTitle: 🔥 Why Jining? (And Why It Matters for Your Sourcing)
insights.art2_hotContent:
Jining, Shandong is where 60% of the world's compact excavator supply chain lives. 200+ factories within 50km. Engines (Kubota/Honda), hydraulics, undercarriages — all sourced locally.

This matters to YOU because:
• Competition keeps prices transparent — you're not overpaying for a "brand" that assembles parts from the same suppliers.
• Vertical integration = faster spare parts. When you need a track motor 6 months later, Jining factories can ship in 48 hours. Try that with a European brand.
• 5 years of quality upgrades. The "cheap but unreliable" reputation is outdated. Export-grade models now match Japanese hydraulics standards.

But — and this is key — Jining has 200+ factories. Some are excellent. Some are not. The rest of this guide is about telling them apart.
insights.art2_profitTitle: 💰 The 5 Most Expensive Mistakes (And How to Avoid Them)
insights.art2_profitContent:
Mistake #1: Choosing "generic diesel" engines.
Fix: Insist on Kubota or Honda. Parts availability worldwide is non-negotiable. If the factory says "same quality, Chinese brand" — walk away.

Mistake #2: Not matching certification to your market.
Fix: CE for EU, EPA for US, RCM for Australia/NZ. Ask for certificate copies BEFORE paying deposit. If they can't provide — next factory.

Mistake #3: Skipping the video factory tour.
Fix: A 10-minute video call costs nothing. You're looking for: actual assembly line (not just a warehouse), spare parts shelf, and — this is the big one — do they have an engine test rig? If they can't show you a running machine during the call, red flag.

Mistake #4: Not calculating total landed cost before committing.
Fix: Machine price is only 50-60% of your total cost. Shipping (40HQ container: $2,000-3,000 for 6-8 units), import duties (US 2.5%, EU 3.7%, Australia 5%), insurance, and port handling. A $3,500 excavator becomes $5,500-7,000 landed. Still 50-70% below Cat/Kubota retail — but you need to know the number before you commit.

Mistake #5: Forgetting spare parts on the first order.
Fix: Bucket teeth, filters, drive belts — order 10-15% extra on your first shipment. It saves weeks of downtime later. The factory price for spare parts is 30-50% of what you'd pay a local dealer.
insights.art2_regionTitle: 🏭 How to Verify a Factory (Without Flying to China)
insights.art2_regionContent:
You don't need to visit Jining to vet a supplier. Here's the 4-step verification that actually works:

Step 1: Video call during factory working hours (China time 8:00-17:00). If they say "our engineer is not available" — that's a trading company, not a factory.

Step 2: Ask for CE/EPA/RCM certificate copies with the manufacturer's name on them. Trading companies will send you "sample certificates" from other factories. The certificate should match the company name on the contract.

Step 3: Check if they have a Kubota or Honda partnership letter. Top-tier Jining factories will show you the authorization letter from the engine supplier. No letter = they're buying "Kubota-compatible" (not genuine) engines.

Step 4: Order 1 unit first. Test the market. Alibaba Trade Assurance protects your deposit. If the machine arrives and it's genuinely good — then order the container.

Red flags: Prices that are "too good" (below $2,500 for 1.8T), no video call, no certificate copies, pushy sales tactics, no spare parts list.
insights.art2_tipsContent:
✅ Certification match: CE/EPA/RCM — certificate copy in hand before paying
✅ Engine: Kubota or Honda only — ask for authorization letter
✅ Video factory tour: 10 minutes, live, during China working hours
✅ Total landed cost calculated: machine + shipping + duties + insurance
✅ Spare parts list: 10-15% extra on first order
✅ Payment: Alibaba Trade Assurance (never wire transfer to personal account)
✅ MOQ clarity: some factories require 3-5 units for export grade; ask before assuming 1 unit is OK
✅ Warranty: 12 months minimum, with spare parts warranty claims process documented
✅ Shipping: 40HQ fits 6-8 units; ask factory for their forwarder rates vs. your own
✅ After-sales: WeChat/WhatsApp response time SLA — ask for reference contacts in your country
insights.art2_productsDesc: These models passed our verification: video factory tour completed, certificates verified, Kubota/Honda engines confirmed, and — for the ones we could check — spare parts shipped within 48 hours of request.
